arg.name: marker_map
arg.description: the site's marker_map.yaml

arg.name: node_name
arg.description: the node's name; its ~/ topics and services follow it

arg.name: mode
arg.description: planar (x, y, yaw on a flat floor) or 3d (6-DoF)

arg.name: pose_topic
arg.description: output, geometry_msgs/PoseWithCovarianceStamped

arg.name: rejected_topic
arg.description: if set: fixes the gate turned down (far from the prior) are published here, for relocalization

arg.name: prior_topic
arg.description: the state estimator's pose, for the gate; empty: no gate

arg.name: prior_type
arg.description: pose (PoseWithCovarianceStamped) or odometry (nav_msgs/Odometry)

arg.name: gate_distance
arg.description: [m] fixes farther from the prior are dropped

arg.name: gate_sigmas
arg.description: the gate widens to this many sd of the prior's own covariance; 0: fixed gate

arg.name: roll_pitch
arg.description: planar: the robot's roll and pitch from zero, tf or imu

arg.name: roll_pitch_frame
arg.description: roll_pitch tf: a level frame, such as odom

arg.name: prior_tolerance
arg.description: [s] the prior pose nearest an image, within this, counts

arg.name: require_prior
arg.description: with prior_topic: publish no fix without a prior near its stamp

arg.name: max_distance
arg.description: [m] leave out markers estimated farther than this; 0: no limit

arg.name: max_position_sd
arg.description: [m] publish no fix with a larger position sd; 0: no limit

arg.name: min_sd
arg.description: [m] added to the fix's position sd (the map's own error)

arg.name: min_sd_deg
arg.description: [deg] added to the fix's angle sd

arg.name: detect_scale
arg.description: under 1: find markers in a downscaled image (large cameras)

arg.name: process_all
arg.description: every frame in order, over a reliable subscription (recordings)

arg.name: param_file
arg.description: YAML of node parameters, read last: its values win over the arguments
